title: Guest Incident Checklist
subtitle: Capture guest account, scene condition, witness, and immediate response; confirm evidence custody and follow-up.
description: Guest Incident records guest account, scene condition, witness, immediate response, evidence custody, and follow-up. Guest Incident evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this guest incident stage-gated verification when staff must document guest account and scene condition. Reconcile witness, immediate response, evidence custody, and follow-up before the guest incident handoff. Use the guest statement, witness contacts, scene photographs, camera-footage custody reference, first-response log, security report, property action, claim route, and follow-up call. Ask the assigned guest incident reviewer to confirm guest account against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Guest and incident scene
sections.guidance: Record exact timing, location, people present, and the guest's account.

sections.title: Immediate response and evidence
sections.guidance: Check actions actually completed; keep observations separate from conclusions.

blocks.label: Response and preservation checks
items: Immediate danger or continuing hazard is assessed
Emergency, first-aid, or other assistance is offered as applicable
Area is controlled without destroying relevant evidence
Manager or security response time is recorded
Guest account is preserved in the guest's words
Witness contact and objective observations are recorded
Photographs or video references preserve source and custody
Affected property or service is identified for correction
Guest received the follow-up contact and expected timing

fields.label: Guest account, observed condition, witness statement, and time

blocks.label: Immediate care, security, or property response

fields.label: Immediate response, assistance offered, action owner, and time

sections.title: Evidence custody and guest follow-up
sections.guidance: Assign evidence, property action, and the next guest contact.

blocks.label: Report and manager receipt
blocks.guidance: Receipt records factual handoff and does not assign fault.
